items.title: One year of full bodies keeps every customer's personal data exposed long after it is needed for debugging
Passwords from login requests are written to the central log system in clear text
Session tokens captured in logged bodies let a log reader act as any user
Full payment details are copied into logs, putting card data in a system not built for it
Logging every full body lets a caller drive log storage cost and volume
Caller-supplied bodies written into logs let an attacker forge log records and poison investigations
